science.explanation: The Empathy Patch for Utah is a proposed system designed to enhance empathy among individuals in the state of Utah. This system utilizes a combination of machine learning algorithms and social media analysis to identify and promote empathetic behaviors.
assumptions: Individuals in Utah have access to smartphones with internet connectivity
Social media platforms can be used as a reliable source of data for empathy-related metrics
